text:
kevin: Deploy finished for canary -> prod-roll started. Scheduled 08:15 UTC. Can folks run quick smoke checks and post ACKs? I'll be on call for 30m. @maya @sam
maya: Running frontend sanity now. Hitting 200 on /health across 3 canaries. Doing login/chat stream checks.
deploy-bot: Deploy job #deploy-324 completed: success. Canary instances: canary-a, canary-b, canary-c.
sam: Checking tokenization latency and KV cache hit rates. Tailing logs: `kubectl logs -f svc/redwood-api` — saw a 2s spike around 08:18 for a few requests.
maya: Frontend smoke: login, send message, streaming all OK. Seeing ~5% errors on multipart upload for large files — digging in.
ana: (typo) -- sorry, meant ana.
ana: -- ignore
ana: Ana here — I'll watch infra metrics and set a short watchlist: cpu, gpu_util, request_5xx_rate. Alert if 5xx > 1%.
kevin: Rollback plan ready? If 5xx trend >1% for 5m we rollback to v1.12. Who takes ownership of rollback?
sam: I can own rollback. Command ready: `./deploy/rollback.sh v1.12`. I'll coordinate and post status.
maya: Quick finding: missing `X-Orig-Host` header in a redirect path causes 415 on large payloads. Patch pushed to canary branch `fix/redirect-header`. Need smoke rerun after deploy.
deploy-bot: Patch build #325 deployed to canary. Smoke-run hook triggered.
ana: Metrics update: p95 180ms (baseline 170ms). KV cache hit 86%. No sustained 5xx spike yet.
kevin: Good. If anything degrades, sam to rollback. If stable, promote in 30m. Please add results to the release doc.
maya: ACK :thumbsup: Will rerun multipart upload tests after patch.
sam: ACK, standing by for rollback.
kevin: Final note: add this run to release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-08-03/canary-checks
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled promotion at 08:45 UTC unless rollback is triggered.
kevin: Thanks all — I'll check back at +15m and again before promote.
